Car loans

Hit the road with hassle-free financing

At a glance

Thinking of buying your own car? A National Bank car loan1 can be tailored to almost any budget—choose the payment options that are best for you. You can request a National Bank car loan at most dealerships.

Perfect if you are looking to:

  • Choose a fixed rate to simplify your finances or a variable rate to take advantage of lower interest rates
  • Choose your payment frequency (weekly, every two weeks or monthly)
  • Repay your loan in full or in part without penalty
  • Enjoy a repayment period of up to eight years1

Go green and save 

If you purchase an electric or hybrid car, benefit from an exciting offer2 applicable on your fixed-rate loan. Make an appointment online. 

Car loans tailored to your situation

Canadian citizens and permanent residents

Have you found the car of your dreams? Apply for financing online in a few easy steps1.

Make an appointment

Newcomers to Canada and temporary residents

If you're a newcomer to Canada, sign up for our offer to get preferred rates on car loans1, even if you don't have a credit history1-3.

Like temporary residents, you are eligible for financing with a 25% down payment4 when the loan exceeds $10,000.

Make an appointment

Tip

Don't leave your debt to loved ones in case of death, disability or critical illness. Make sure you're protected with loan insurance.

  2. The offer is eligible based on the in-branch car loan. This offer is not available at merchants that already offer National Bank financing. 
  3. Subject to approval by National Bank. Certain conditions apply.  
  4. Newcomers and temporary residents are required to make a down payment of 25% of the value of the loan for financing of $10,000 or more to a maximum of $75,000. No financing is permitted above this amount and for any type of vehicle over 8 years old. Certain conditions apply. 
  5. Subject to not exceeding the maximum line of credit amount available, i.e., 65% of the value of the property.
